g.text: Reconstructs how a small business operates by analysing the conversations its team
already has. A flagged chat message seeds a process graph, and recurring patterns are
promoted into templates the team can approve and execute. The domain layer is kept free
of framework and persistence dependencies, so process logic is testable in isolation.
Java 21 · Spring Boot 3.5 · Spring Data JPA · React 19 · PostgreSQL 16 · Flyway · Docker · Testcontainers
